messages.text:
The two of us make an amazing
combination! Let's battle!{be01}

Sola: Our amazing combination
had no impact on you!{be01}
Ana: I can't believe it! We should
have been perfect, but we lost!

If my sister is full of energy,
then I'm full of energy, too!{be01}
It's kind of like we have the
Pokémon Ability called Synchronize!

Oh, you only have one Pokémon...
It would be more fun if you had more!

The teamwork of Twins...
A true example of perfection!{be01}

Even though we look the same,
our parents can always tell us apart!

Only one Pokémon?
I can't believe it... How could you?
